title: Vickers Wellington X3707
memorial_details: A small concrete cairn with a metal plaque sat at the top. Concrete bricks make up the outer facade of the cairn; the centre of the cairn is solid concrete. This plaque details the names of the airmen who perished in the plane crash.
inscription: PLAQUE : In Memory of / (NAMES) / Who tragically lost their lives when their aircraft, Vickers Wellington X3707, crashed at Craiglockhart View on14th December 1942.
custodian: CraigLockhart Community Council and The City of Edinburgh Council South West Neighbourhood Partnership
